name: Strained Lentil Soup
instructions: Chop the onion and carrot and sauté in olive oil.
Add the washed lentils and hot water, and cook until the lentils are tender.
Blend the soup until smooth and serve hot.

name: Biga Method Pizza Dough
instructions: Prepare the pre-ferment (biga) by mixing the flour, yeast, and 60% of the water, and rest in the refrigerator for 16 hours.
Add the remaining water and salt, and knead into a smooth dough.
Divide into dough balls and apply cold fermentation for 24-48 hours.

name: Tulum Cheese and Chocolate Dessert
instructions: Melt the dark chocolate and butter using a bain-marie.
Add the crumbled tulum cheese and honey to the chocolate mixture.
Pour into molds and bake in the oven at 180°C for 10 minutes.
